title: Class 10 Science - Motion & Forces
instructions: Award marks strictly per criterion. No negative marking. Accept equivalent correct phrasings.

questions.question_text: State Newton's second law of motion and write its mathematical form.
questions.model_answer: The rate of change of momentum of a body is directly proportional to the applied force and takes place in the direction of the force. Mathematically, F = ma.

criteria.description: States the law in words (rate of change of momentum proportional to force, or equivalent)
Writes the correct equation F = ma with symbols identified or obvious from context

questions.question_text: A car of mass 1000 kg accelerates from rest to 20 m/s in 10 s. Calculate the force applied.

criteria.description: Applies F = ma with their acceleration value
Correct final answer with unit (2000 N)

questions.question_text: Explain why a passenger falls backward when a bus suddenly starts moving.
questions.model_answer: Due to inertia of rest, the lower body moves with the bus while the upper body tends to remain at rest, so the passenger falls backward.

criteria.description: Identifies inertia (of rest) as the cause
Explains that the lower body moves with the bus while the upper body resists the change
